annotations.title: List the event types of a calendar integration

description:
List the event types of a calendar integration

Returns the kinds of appointment that can be booked through this integration, read live from the calendar provider: their name, their duration in minutes and their identifier. An empty list means the calendar has no event types; a provider that cannot be reached or refuses is answered with 502 `provider_error`, not with an empty list.
name: list_integration_event_types
title: List the event types of a calendar integration
